job.description:
Since 2012, Rightsline has been making work easier for rights and royalties professionals with our innovative rights and royalties management software, allowing our customers to maximize their portfolios without having to max out their daily to-do-lists.
Our fully integrated and configurable platform provides customers with comprehensive access to all their rights and royalties, across all markets and platforms, instantly. Departments can communicate, collaborate, and cohesively take action without worrying about mistakes; and in-app reports and timely alerts ensure our customers never miss an opportunity to do more.
The Position
The Sr. RevOps Analyst drives top-of-funnel velocity, pipeline conversion efficiency, and day-to-day sales operational excellence. This role is responsible for monitoring funnel bottlenecks, ensuring adherence to lead routing and stage-exit criteria, administering territory and quota allocations, and providing commercial teams with actionable reporting and analytics. This role is based in the Greater Toronto Area (hybrid), reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations.
Mission & Impact
Support faster lead follow-up, healthier pipelines, and timely, actionable commercial reporting through accurate funnel analytics and disciplined sales operations. Performance is measured by lead conversion improvement, SLA adherence, clean pipeline records, and on-time forecast reporting.
What You Will OwnFunnel Analytics & Conversion Tracking
Monitor stage-by-stage pipeline velocity, tracking conversion metrics from Lead → MQL → SQL → Opportunity → Closed-Won to identify stalled pipeline and process friction.
Inbound & Outbound SLA Enforcement
Oversee lead routing performance and audit sales response times against agreed SLAs, ensuring rapid follow-up on high-value inbound leads.
Territory & Quota Administration
Support the annual and mid-year territory carving processes, manage account assignment balance, maintain quota files, and calculate monthly attainment metrics.
Pipeline Hygiene & Deal Inspection
Audit pipeline records for compliance with sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC), stage exit criteria, close-date validity, and next-step documentation.
Commercial Reporting & Dashboards
Build and maintain operational dashboards for Sales and Marketing leadership, providing daily and weekly visibility into pacing, coverage ratios, and campaign ROI.
Marketing Collaboration & Attribution
Partner with Marketing to assess campaign performance, lead scoring thresholds, campaign hierarchy tracking, and lead-to-revenue attribution.
Key Deliverables & Performance KPIs
Lead-to-Opportunity Conversion Lift
SLA Adherence: >95% of qualified leads contacted within target SLA windows.
Pipeline Hygiene Index: Zero overdue opportunities or missing close dates at month-end.
Forecast Cadence Readiness: Weekly forecast decks and pacing reports delivered on schedule.
Technical Boundary & Clean Handoff
Primary Boundary: Interfaces directly with field sellers, SDRs, and marketing campaign managers to analyze process bottlenecks. Translates field operational issues into requirements for schema modifications or automated pipeline enrichment.
What You Will Bring
2 to 4 years of analytical experience in Operations, Marketing Operations, or Revenue Operations in B2B SaaS.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (complex formulas, index/match, pivot tables) and BI reporting tools.
Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboard building; familiarity with ZoomInfo and Clay workflows.
Strong quantitative problem-solving ability with clear written and verbal communication skills.
Our Core Values
At Rightsline, we look for these qualities in every hire, and we hold ourselves to them every day.
Be Curious and Smart
Being smart isn't about having all the answers — it's about asking the right questions, seeking out new ideas, and never assuming you already know enough.
Embrace Change
This industry moves fast and so do we. We don't resist change — we lean into it. That means staying flexible, letting go of what isn't working, and treating uncertainty as opportunity rather than obstacle.
Show Up
Showing up means being present — not just physically, but mentally and emotionally. Your teammates count on you. Your customers count on you. We do our best work when everyone is fully engaged and accountable to each other.
Get it Done
Ideas are easy. Execution is the job. We hold ourselves to what we commit to, push through the hard parts, and measure success by our actual accomplishments.
Be Humble
Nobody here has a monopoly on good ideas. We listen more than we talk, share credit freely, and check our egos at the door. The best outcome matters more than whose idea it was.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Rightsline is an equal opportunity workplace. All candidates will be afforded equal opportunity through the recruiting process. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity and/or expression. We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented individuals and creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.
If you are contacted for an interview and require accommodation during the interviewing process, please let us know.
Apply Today
If you want to join a company that strives for a mission, purpose and making an impact, we encourage you to apply today.

job.description:
The Company 
 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond. We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments.
When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.
AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.
This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.
 The Role
 The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.
This role owns critical components of revenue operations, including sales compensation execution, performance analytics, and executive reporting. In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.
As a key contributor to strategic planning and revenue optimization, this individual plays a central role in enabling predictable, scalable growth while continuously evolving reporting frameworks, compensation programs, and operational processes.
 What You Do
 Sales Compensation Ownership & Strategy
Own the build and end-to-end administration of sales compensation programs, including plan implementation, maintenance, and commission calculations.
Test new plans and changes before release. Document expected results, check edge cases, and validate Salesforce inputs and commission calculations against approved plan terms.
Lead monthly and quarterly compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery.
Partner with Finance, People, and RevOps leadership to ensure alignment with payroll, audit, and compliance requirements.
Analyze compensation effectiveness and lead modeling efforts to optimize plan design and align incentives with business objectives.
Identify and implement process improvements to increase scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of compensation operations.
 Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting
Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.
Design and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide clear visibility into business performance.
Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, productivity, and forecasting trends, influencing strategic decision-making.
Lead complex data analysis initiatives, synthesizing insights across multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, BI tools).
Partner with senior leadership to support planning cycles, QBRs, and strategic initiatives.
 AI Agents and Workflow Automation
Identify and prioritize RevOps workflows for agentic AI based on business impact, manual effort, data readiness, and risk. Define the expected outcome and how to measure it before building.
Build and maintain multi-step workflows with Claude or comparable tools. Define which data sources each workflow uses, what it checks, and when it routes an exception to a person.
Strengthen Board and executive reporting. Build workflows to reconcile metrics across Salesforce, Power BI, and Finance, flag unexplained variances, and draft commentary tied to verified figures for human review.
Support GTM planning and analysis. Use agentic workflows to compare quota, capacity, and territory scenarios, document assumptions, and show which inputs drive the largest changes in projected bookings.
Validate workflows before release and after changes. Test against known outcomes and edge cases, track false positives and missed exceptions, and require human approval before workflows update records or distribute sensitive reports.
Measure results and support adoption. Track time saved, exception accuracy, and usage. Document workflows and train analysts and business partners to run them, review outputs, and troubleshoot common issues.
 GTM Systems Administration
Own day-to-day administration of Gong and assigned sales intelligence tools. Manage user access, permissions, licenses, team structures, and platform settings.
Configure Gong to support weekly forecast reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching. Build and maintain views that help leaders spot deal risk, track forecast changes, and prepare for pipeline reviews.
Configure sales intelligence tools to support account research, prospecting, and contact enrichment. Set rules for which data flows into Salesforce and how to handle duplicates or conflicting values.
Monitor data flow between Gong, sales intelligence tools, and Salesforce. Investigate sync failures and data discrepancies. Partner with GTM Systems and vendors on integration changes and escalations.
Lead testing and rollout of new features. Document configurations, train users, and track adoption and license usage to inform renewal and expansion decisions.
Build agentic AI workflows that combine approved Gong and Salesforce data to flag deal risks and prepare forecast review briefs. Link findings to source records and route them to sales leaders for review.
 What You Bring
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or related analytical roles, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and administering production commission plans in Spiff.
Experience owning full sales compensation cycles, including payout reconciliation, exception resolution, and approval workflows.
Experience producing Board or executive leadership reporting, including reconciling metrics across systems and writing concise variance commentary.
Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as Claude or comparable platforms
Experience connecting agents to business systems, troubleshooting failures, and validating results.
Advanced Salesforce and Excel skills and experience building or maintaining reporting in Power BI or a comparable BI platform.
 Asset Qualifications
Experience with commission tools (e.g., SPIFF or similar platforms).
Proficiency in SQL or other data querying languages.
Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV) and recurring revenue models.
Experience with territory planning, quota setting, and GTM strategy.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive process improvements.
Note: This position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on the Government of Canada's security screening process, please visit Public Services and Procurement Canada.
Versaterm is committed to fair and equitable compensation that is competitive, consistent, and aligned with the value each role contributes to our organization. The starting salary for this position will be dependent upon many factors, such as the successful candidate's skills, experience, education, training as well as internal equity, market data, and business needs. In addition to base salary and our comprehensive benefits offering, some roles may also be eligible for variable compensation such as incentive plans or discretionary performance bonuses.
AI is central to how Versaterm builds and delivers solutions for our customers. Within Talent Acquisition, we use AI-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, helping our team work more efficiently and spend more time connecting with great talent. AI supports our work, but all hiring and employment decisions are made by people.
Versaterm is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and a barrier-free workplace. Accommodations are available upon request throughout all stages of the recruitment process and apply to the terms and conditions of employment. For more information, please contact info@versaterm.com.

job.description:
Location: UK OR Amsterdam
Reports to: Director, Revenue Strategy & Operations, EMEA
Travel: Up to 20%
 About Horizon3.ai
 Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company helping organisations proactively find, fix, and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our NodeZero platform delivers production-safe autonomous pentesting across internal, external, cloud, and hybrid-cloud environments.
We are learn-it-alls who value respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.
 About The Role
 We are hiring a Senior Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager to be the hands-on operating partner to the Director of Revenue Strategy & Operations as our EMEA go-to-market organisation scales.
This is a roll-up-your-sleeves role in a small, fast-growing team with lots to build and take ownership of. You will run the EMEA operating rhythm, from forecast and pipeline inspection to planning and performance reviews, and help shape our overarching GTM strategy & execution. You will become the trusted advisor to the Director, problem solving at pace, driving efficiencies through AI, and advocating for EMEA's needs as we evolve global infrastructure.
 What You'll Do
Run the forecast and pipeline inspection process. Pressure-test commitments, flag risk early, and prepare clear call-outs for leadership.
Analyse the funnel and conversion using MEDDPICC. Find where deals stall and why, then run the programmes that fix conversion.
Own the quota capacity model, including the hiring roadmap, overlay coverage, and territory and account routing.
Deploy quotas and handle territory changes and crediting questions.
Turn data into decisions. Answer the "why" behind win rates, cycle times, and slippage, and recommend the action, not just the chart.
Build and maintain performance reporting, QBR materials, and dashboards on central data.
Set and enforce CRM data standards, in line with global ones. Diagnose routing and data exceptions across data, process and systems, and drive permanent fixes.
Own EMEA field requests: triage them, resolve what you can, and route the rest to the global systems team.
As the business scales, build a data-driven land-and-expand strategy: find where expansion is won and lost, and track NRR and churn risk.
Automate recurring manual work with AI wherever possible, then hand proven tools to the teams that own the platforms.
Support FY28 planning: headcount, quota, and territory scenarios with Finance and GTM leaders.
Work with the Director and GTM leaders on segmentation, resourcing, budget allocation, and where to invest in EMEA.
Align metric definitions and operating cadence with global RevOps, and feed EMEA insight into global decisions on planning, tooling, and GTM design.
 What You'll Bring
6 to 8 years in RevOps, Sales Ops, GTM Ops, commercial analytics, or a closely related role, ideally at a high-growth B2B company.
Enterprise experience: you understand multi-threaded, multi-year deals and have worked with a stage-gate methodology such as MEDDPICC.
Deeply curious and data-led. You dive deep, go beyond the dashboard to find root causes, and work across both land and expand.
Structured problem-solver. You define the issue, quantify its impact, find the root cause, and confirm the fix worked.
Hands-on technical depth. You build and run your own analysis, and are comfortable working in Salesforce.
Commercial sharpness. You understand how the whole revenue engine fits together, and how a change in one area shifts the rest.
AI-first. You have built workflows, agents, or reusable AI tools that others rely on, and can show examples.
High agency. You work independently through ambiguity, set your own priorities, and follow work through to completion.
Influence beyond your team. You can persuade global functional leaders to adopt a change, and earn trust with sales leaders and reps.
Clear communication. You can challenge a forecast with data in the room.
You understand EMEA SaaS markets, including how selling and compliance differ across countries.
 What You'll Get
Real scope in a small, fast-scaling EMEA team. You will own the EMEA operating rhythm and be trusted with the numbers that leadership uses.
Direct access to sales leadership in a high-growth international business.
Exposure to global decisions, and the chance to shape how they are made.
The autonomy to introduce better processes and practical automation, and the backing to see them through.
A working partnership with your Director, who values new ideas and expects you to bring them.
Remote working across EMEA with a collaborative, ownership-oriented team.
Access to best-of-breed tools, and the chance to shape how we use them.
Full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.
Horizon3.ai is committed to an inclusive, equitable workplace with opportunities for growth and development.

We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.
 Your Role 
bunch is growing its sales team in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Each account executive owns a set of named accounts and reaches out when something happens at one of them, for example a new fundraise or a new CFO. You build and run the system that supports this: the data on our market of fund managers, the signals that tell an account executive when to reach out, and the preparation of outreach.
You will:
Prepare a book of accounts for every new Account Executive, with the right contacts and the CRM history.
Keep the fund managers in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany up to date in HubSpot.
Create HubSpot tasks from signals such as fundraises, regulator registrations (FCA, BaFin, CSSF), new hires in finance and operations, and contacts who change firm.
Set up a weekly account brief for each account executive and drafted messages that improve from account executive feedback.
Show account executives who at bunch already knows someone at an account to increase a partnership revenue channel.
Get recorded calls into HubSpot, and add stage rules and required fields that keep the CRM data clean.
Route inbound leads to the account executive who owns the account.
Build all of this as code that is scheduled, monitored and documented.
 About you 
3+ years building a GTM or revenue operations system end to end at a B2B company.
You understand how B2B sales teams work and like to work closely with account executives.
Deep HubSpot knowledge: custom objects, associations, workflows, the API, and where HubSpot breaks.
Daily use of Claude or similar AI tools, and a clear view of where they fail and where they can be put to use for account executives.
Knowledge of the modern data stack (ingestion, warehouse, transformation, reverse ETL, enrichment) and how it connects to the CRM.
You know which leading indicators to track, why they predict revenue, and how to make them reliable in the CRM.
 Workplace & Benefits 
Hybrid work 
28 days of paid vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays.
Up to 6 working weeks a year working remotely from abroad, subject to approval and location restrictions.
Flexible benefits budget for options including food, mobility and sport.
A great tech and work setup, and a learning and development budget after probation in line with your approved development plan
 Hiring process 
 Screening with Ivo, our Analytics Lead and Hiring Manager for the role 45 minutes).
 Case Interview | Architecture) with Ivo (30 minutes).
 Case Interview | Process with Strategy & Marketing (45 minutes).
 Final Interview with Enrico, our Co-Founder and Commercial Leader (30 minutes).
Questions? Reach out to Recruiting@bunch.capital .

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.
